status_semantics: CLOSED_SOURCE means implemented with scoped local regressions; exact-head CI and independent review remain separate. OPEN is permitted here and must not be hidden by historical zero-open ledgers.

gaps.title: Inert fixture and exact historical object acknowledgement
G10 prose compatibility and typed controls
Reverse tracked-source ownership and plugin registration
gaps.claim_ceiling: Checker and regressions implemented; actual full-checkout ownership remains a required CI assertion, not inferred from local fixture tests.

gaps.title: Atomic current-consent memory and bounded retention
Production implementations behind provider/infrastructure gates
gaps.close_criteria: Implement persistent identity/revocation, KMS/attestation adapters, production model/realtime/OAuth adapters, Android ASR, durable capability recovery, asymmetric Skill verification/sandbox and encrypted Memory. Keep deployed evidence gates separate.

gaps.title: Full semantic module handoff and cross-language contracts
gaps.close_criteria: Review every module's API/state/error/config/migration/runbook/test matrix; replace smoke-only UI coverage; implement cross-language conformance vectors and document supported/unsupported platform behavior. Path coverage alone cannot close this row.

gaps.title: Adopt reviewed candidate into authoritative main without bypass
gaps.close_criteria: Obtain complete latest-head CI/artifacts, eligible independent review, canonical protection readback and authorized stack adoption; regenerate exact-head evidence after base changes. Do not self-merge or delete historical evidence.
